MaterialPath (m)

Finite-model reference outlines

Through-material geometry references, not certified physical envelopes. Known artificial terrain caps and incident edges are excluded. Structure/water boundaries and terrain beyond the finite model remain unresolved. These controls are independent of sampled depth diagnostics.

Sampled boundary diagnostics

Applied to both maps, using unsmoothed BVH material paths. Depth edges are sampled discontinuities, not CAD edges. Rock is limited to the published terrain volume.

Material contribution contours

Independent of envelope/depth diagnostics and colour scale. These are sampled material contributions, not geometric envelopes or detectable-signal claims. Adaptive levels differ by material and graph; use explicit levels for comparisons.

Material projection

Detector-local slope map of column density (m.w.e.), not predicted counts. Click a pixel to inspect its ray.

Horizontal: local right; vertical: local up. Adaptive colors are normalized per view; use fixed scale for comparisons.

Detector assessment

Shared main-app quick-response model on the published BVH geometry. Approximate counts, not a calibrated performance prediction.

Site / pose comparison

Save completed assessments before changing site or pose. The same raw indicator definitions are used for every row. No automatic ranking, significance, safety or access score.

Contour JSON v1 includes selected raw fields, exact levels, slope lines, snapshots and completeness. Visibility/styles are separate. Hidden layers still export selected scientific fields; invalid levels prevent contour export.

The assessment uses the full device field, not the material-map half angle. Counts include detector acceptance and resolution smoothing; readouts/export retain raw values. No ROI significance or continuous-water approximation is enabled.

Water levels are fixed to published scenarios. Cavity overlays and reference geometry are display options; they do not change material paths.
